statement: A bounded one-pass differential census over the EXISTING rolling-restart stat-gate report corpus (no new gates) decides whether any single structural feature separates PASS from FAIL runs at a pre-stated margin. Candidate features: which node becomes the CPU-pegged rejoiner, how many of the ~34 leaderships co-locate on that rejoiner, and whether the source-removal/REPLACE drain deadline (~120s) elapses. Terminal: EITHER a named discriminating feature with a pre-stated separation margin and its supporting run partition, OR an honest verdict that no single structural feature separates PASS from FAIL on the corpus, which escalates/abandons the run4 line rather than re-hunting.

constraints.statement: This Quest reads ONLY the existing report corpus under test-output/reports/. It must not launch stat-gate runs, fast-local runs, or any new scenario execution. Its cost is bounded to reading artifacts already on disk.

The candidate feature list and the separation margin must be recorded (in a finding or the verdict scaffold) BEFORE scoring the corpus. Adding features or relaxing the margin after seeing scores is a goalpost violation.

Before closure, spawn a subagent to independently verify the verdict artifact: that the PASS/FAIL partition is read from real report verdicts, that the claimed separation (or null) matches the data, and that no new gates were run. Record the verification as a finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

doneWhenSealed.method: Bounded ONE-PASS differential census over the EXISTING stat-gate report corpus already on disk under test-output/reports/ (NO new gate runs, no fast-local re-execution). Partition every run into PASS vs FAIL from its recorded verdict, then score the pre-committed candidate features once.
doneWhenSealed.candidateFeatures: Committed BEFORE any scoring: (1) rejoiner-node identity - which node rejoins as the CPU-pegged node; (2) leadership co-location count - how many of the ~34 leaderships pin on that rejoiner; (3) source-removal / REPLACE drain-deadline (~120s) elapsed vs not. No feature may be added or swapped after seeing the scores.
doneWhenSealed.separationMargin: A candidate 'separates' PASS from FAIL only if the PASS and FAIL distributions differ by a margin fixed and written into the verdict BEFORE scoring. Baseline to beat: the parent run4 CPU tail did NOT separate (PASS 73.2 pct overlaps FAIL 74.9 pct), so any claimed separator must clear a margin strictly better than that overlap.
doneWhenSealed.terminalBranches: SOLVED-branch: a named discriminating feature + its pre-stated margin + the supporting PASS/FAIL run partition, written to the verdict artifact and subagent-verified. ESCALATE-branch: an honest verdict that NO single candidate feature separates PASS from FAIL at the margin, recommending escalation/abandonment of the run4 line. Both branches set done=true; a null-separator verdict is a SUCCESSFUL census, not a failure to be re-run.
doneWhenSealed.killCriterion: Exactly ONE pass over the corpus and the pre-committed candidate list. Re-running gates, widening the feature list after a null result, or re-hunting inside operation_workflow_owner is a goalpost violation - the honest move on a null verdict is escalate/abandon, not continue.
doneWhenSealed.verdictArtifact: test-output/reports/passfail-discriminator-census.verdict.json carrying {done:true, verdict:'separator-found'|'no-separator', feature:string|null, margin, passRuns:[], failRuns:[], recommendation}, subagent-verified before closure.
doneWhenSealed.inheritedContext: Supersedes parked work on rolling-restart-run4-operation-drain (operator-stopped: symptom-surface frontier, blocker-oscillation high) and its EXHAUSTED grandparent rolling-restart-run4-drain-residual (same CPU-latency-tail root, non-discriminating observable).
